title: Manifest derivation
responsibility: Builds an active unit manifest from source facts while retaining declared contracts, responsibilities, dependencies and runtime choices.

inputs.name: deriveContract.files
inputs.description: Source records whose paths, exports, optional storage declarations, and scanned errors are folded into the contract. An empty array produces an empty derived contract.

inputs.name: deriveContract.entry
inputs.description: Repository-relative source path used to select a primary component export when that file is present. If no matching component is found, inputs fall back to all deduplicated component exports; defaults to undefined.

inputs.name: declaredContract.declared
inputs.description: Previously authored contract whose item explanations and explicitly declared operation errors are applied by matching names. Source-derived signatures and arrays refresh the corresponding authored entries.

inputs.name: declaredContract.source
inputs.description: Freshly derived contract providing current input and operation signatures, optional literal defaults, snippets, and storage facts. Its inputs, snippets, storage, initialization, and operation entries replace the corresponding authored arrays, while contract-level outputs remain from the declared contract.

inputs.name: operationContract.symbol
inputs.description: One scanned exported symbol used to form a contract operation entry. Its name, inputs, optional output, observed errors, and error status determine the returned fields.

inputs.name: deriveManifest.input
inputs.description: Unit identity and kind, owned source records, a repository-path-to-unit owner map, and optional predecessor ids or previous manifest. When there is no previous manifest, at least one source path is needed because defaults derive the title from the first file.

outputs.name: deriveManifest
outputs.description: A schema-validated active manifest with source and symbol ownership, dependency facts, runtime, contract, scenarios, and budgets. It preserves declared metadata and lineage while refreshing source-derived facts.

examples.title: Manifest derivation
examples.responsibility: Builds an active unit manifest from source facts while retaining declared contracts, responsibilities, dependencies and runtime choices.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown when there is no previous manifest and input.files is empty, because default title generation reads the first file path.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Thrown by componentManifestSchema.shape.contract.parse when the assembled contract fails contract-schema validation.

inputs.name: deriveContract.files
inputs.description: Source records whose paths, exports, optional storage declarations, and scanned errors are folded into the contract. An empty array produces an empty derived contract.

inputs.name: deriveContract.entry
inputs.description: Repository-relative source path used to select a primary component export when that file is present. If no matching component is found, inputs fall back to all deduplicated component exports; defaults to undefined.

outputs.name: deriveContract
outputs.description: A source-derived contract combining selected component props or storage fields with exported return types, scanned errors, snippets, and callable operations. Optional storage and snippets appear only when source facts provide them.

inputs.name: declaredContract.declared
inputs.description: Previously authored contract whose item explanations and explicitly declared operation errors are applied by matching names. Source-derived signatures and arrays refresh the corresponding authored entries.

inputs.name: declaredContract.source
inputs.description: Freshly derived contract providing current input and operation signatures, optional literal defaults, snippets, and storage facts. Its inputs, snippets, storage, initialization, and operation entries replace the corresponding authored arrays, while contract-level outputs remain from the declared contract.

outputs.name: declaredContract
outputs.description: The declared contract with source-derived inputs, snippets, storage, initialization, and operations refreshed. Matching authored explanations survive, and authored operation errors survive only when their error status is declared.

inputs.name: operationContract.symbol
inputs.description: One scanned exported symbol used to form a contract operation entry. Its name, inputs, optional output, observed errors, and error status determine the returned fields.

outputs.name: operationContract
outputs.type: { name: string; inputs: ExportedSymbol['inputs']; outputs: { name: string; type: string }[]; errors: { name: string; type: string }[]; errorStatus: NonNullable<ExportedSymbol['errorStatus']> }
outputs.description: A contract representation of one scanned export, with input items, zero or one return item, thrown-error names, and the export's scanned error status.

outputs.name: deriveManifest
outputs.description: A schema-validated active manifest with source and symbol ownership, dependency facts, runtime, contract, scenarios, and budgets. It preserves declared metadata and lineage while refreshing source-derived facts.
